hooks.command: ROOT="$PWD"; while [ ! -e "$ROOT/.aorch/hooks/user-prompt-submit.mjs" ] && [ "$ROOT" != "/" ]; do ROOT="$(dirname "$ROOT")"; done; if [ -e "$ROOT/.aorch/hooks/user-prompt-submit.mjs" ]; then node "$ROOT/.aorch/hooks/user-prompt-submit.mjs"; else echo "aorch: no .aorch/hooks above $PWD" >&2; fi
